author_confirmation: The user confirmed execution in the priority order of plan_revision v1.0

depmap_primary_endpoint.column_semantics: dependency probability; stronger dependency is larger
depmap_primary_endpoint.release_claim: 25Q3, to be verified in M2 against source filenames or metadata

depmap_secondary_endpoint.column_semantics: Chronos gene effect; stronger dependency is more negative
depmap_secondary_endpoint.current_local_status: missing_at_freeze; M0 inventory must retain this failure

primary_shift.name: real_shift_mean_abs
primary_shift.definition: mean absolute gene-wise difference between perturbed and matched-control mean log1p normalized expression

equal_n_subsampling.secondary_policy: restrict to targets with at least the requested depth and report retained target count

matched_size_control_null.reference: controls not selected into the pseudo-perturbed sample

coverage_sensitivity.low_coverage_exclusion: exclude targets below the within-context 10th percentile of n_cells_target
coverage_sensitivity.extreme_count_exclusion: exclude targets outside the within-context 5th to 95th percentile of n_cells_target

covariates.primary_library_complexity: median raw transcriptome total counts among perturbed cells
covariates.secondary_library_complexity: median detected-gene count among perturbed cells
covariates.baseline_target_expression: matched-control mean normalized log1p expression of the target gene
covariates.rna_level_reduction_strength: negative of target-gene perturbed-minus-control normalized log1p mean
covariates.partial_rank_method: Spearman correlation between residuals from OLS on rank-transformed variables
covariates.complete_case_policy: model-specific complete cases with n reported
covariates.response_breadth_interpretation: incremental biological decomposition, not complete technical deconfounding

inference.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each prespecified analysis family

revised_gate_1.primary_context_requirement: both HCC38 and HCC1143 must pass to retain the dual-context primary endpoint-object claim

metric_revision.primary_directional_metric: signed cosine between predicted and observed shift vectors
metric_revision.secondary_magnitude_retaining_metric: absolute scalar projection onto the observed unit response vector
